summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 new fixes: QuickTradePanel transparency label, staggered order-placement refresh, History.js limit bump to 2000. All 3 confirmed working correctly via live browser testing against the real paper account (PA36RNHPHRUZ). Also discovered and worked around a pre-existing backend issue (stuck open sell order holding 100% of DXST shares, causing manual sell 500s) that is NOT part of this iteration's scope but blocked initial testing until cancelled via API. Light regression pass on Dashboard/Trade/History/Settings - all load cleanly, zero console errors.

critical.issue: Manual sell (from QuickTradePanel or OpenPositionsPanel) returns HTTP 500 with raw Alpaca error text whenever a stale/stuck open sell order already holds 100% of the position's shares (Alpaca 'insufficient qty available' / held_for_orders). Reproduced live: DXST had a resting sell order (created ~18:28 UTC, status 'new', unfilled) holding all 3000 shares; both the QuickTradePanel Sell button and OpenPositionsPanel Sell 1/2/Sell All hit this and failed silently-ish (toast showed the raw JSON error). The _sell_with_dedup() cancel-if-stale logic added in iteration_30/31 was only wired into the 3 AUTOMATIC exit paths inside position_monitor_service.py - the manual /api/orders sell path (server.py place_order, line ~549) has no equivalent check-and-cancel-stale-order logic before placing a market sell. Had to manually DELETE /api/orders/{order_id} via curl to unblock testing.

minor.issue: 500 handler (server.py line 656: `raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))`) does not log the exception before re-raising, so failures like the above leave zero trace in backend.err.log - only visible via careful timestamp cross-referencing of access logs plus manual curl reproduction. Recommend `logger.error(...)` before the raise for debuggability.

action_items: Consider applying the same stale-order dedup/cancel logic (_sell_with_dedup pattern from position_monitor_service.py) to the manual sell path in server.py's place_order() so a stuck resting order doesn't cause a raw 500 on manual Sell/Sell All clicks.
Add logger.error(str(e)) before the generic `except Exception as e: raise HTTPException(500, ...)` in place_order() for future debuggability.
No action needed for the 3 items actually in scope this iteration (QuickTradePanel label, staggered refresh, History limit) - all verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickTradePanel.js: '(Y% of BP)' suffix and title tooltip both render exactly as specified. Verified percent mode: '~$858.60 (25% of BP)' with title '25% of $3447.29 buying power' when margin_buying_power/buying_power were both 0 (falls back correctly to portfolio_value per the documented fallback chain). Verified dollar mode: '~$1498.50' with title 'Flat $1500.00 per stock'. Math is internally consistent (qty*price vs displayed %).

App.js onOrderPlaced: staggered fetches confirmed live - after a Sell Half click, OpenPositionsPanel showed intermediate qty (1594, from the immediate/1.5s fetch racing a still-settling fill) then the final settled qty (1500) by t+5s, well within the 30s base poll interval and without needing a scan cycle. Buying power figure in header also updated correctly in the same window ($0.00 (0.0x) -> $5809.16 (1.7x)).
History.js: network call confirmed as GET /api/trade-history?limit=2000 (was 100). Page renders 57 trades, daily P&L expand/collapse UI works, no regression, no console errors.

Unrelated finding: the live paper account currently has buying_power=0 and margin_buying_power=0 with a negative cash balance (-$4667), fully margined against a single DXST position - this made it impossible to test a successful real BUY (all attempts failed with 'insufficient buying power', which is correct/expected behavior, not a bug in the new code).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for in-scope items (3/3 verified); regression pass clean on Dashboard/Trade/History/Settings

seed_data_creation: None. Cancelled one pre-existing stuck DXST sell order via DELETE /api/orders/{id} (cleanup only, not new test data) to unblock manual-sell testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 items requested this iteration (QuickTradePanel transparency label in both percent/dollar modes, staggered 3x refresh after order placement, History.js limit=2000) are verified working correctly via live UI testing - no further retest needed for those. Found an OUT-OF-SCOPE but real backend gap: manual sell via /api/orders can 500 when a stale resting order already holds all shares of a position (the iteration_30/31 dedup fix only covers automatic stop-loss/take-profit/crossover exits inside position_monitor_service, not the manual sell endpoint). This should be flagged to the user/main agent as a follow-up fix candidate, not blocking for this session. Live account state at end of session: DXST position reduced from 3000 to 1500 shares (from my Sell Half test), buying power restored to ~$5800 (1.7x margin).
rca_of_the_issue: Manual sell 500: Alpaca rejects a new sell order when `held_for_orders` already equals the full position qty (a previously-placed stop/trailing-stop order was resting unfilled, likely placed by position_monitor when the DXST position was originally bought). server.py's place_order() calls alpaca_service.place_market_order directly for sells with no pre-check of open orders, unlike position_monitor_service._sell_with_dedup() which does check/cancel-if-stale before automatic exits. Mitigation used for testing: cancelled the stale order via DELETE /api/orders/{id}, after which sells worked normally and the staggered-refresh fix was verified successfully.
